episode_title: The Repurpose Your Career Podcast is now The Full Arc of Life: Transitions in the Second Half #338

real_qa.q: What major life event caused Mark Beller to pause the Repurpose Your Career Podcast for three years?
real_qa.r: On September 19, 2023, the day after the last episode was published, Mark Beller's wife of 42 years underwent open heart surgery to replace her heart mitral valve in Guadalajara, Mexico. During that surgery, she suffered a major stroke that left her with paralysis on her left side and affected the part of the brain that controlled mood and impulse control. Nine days short of a year later, she died. Mark shut everything down to take care of her and manage her recovery during this horrific year.
real_qa.requete: Mark Beller Repurpose Your Career Podcast three year pause

real_qa.q: Why is Mark Beller renaming Repurpose Your Career to The Full Arc of Life?
real_qa.r: Mark Beller is expanding the scope past career transitions in the second half to write and podcast about the whole arc of life, not just the parts we planned for. The loss of his wife reorganized what he thought work was for. He now wants to talk to other people over 50 who are in the middle of major transitions like widowhood, retirement, a diagnosis, or a divorce—any transition that rewrites the plan—and share what they're learning about what actually helps.
real_qa.requete: Repurpose Your Career Podcast renamed Full Arc of Life

real_qa.q: What is Mark Beller's experience with major life transitions before his wife's stroke?
real_qa.r: Mark Beller's career included 22 years at IBM, a handful of startups, a hard stretch teaching high school, a season raising money for a Jewish community nonprofit, and a bicycle accident in 2002 where he had only a 10% chance of surviving. Every one of those chapters taught him something he didn't know he needed, and he eventually built a career out of helping other people see the same thing about their own winding paths.
real_qa.requete: Mark Beller career transitions IBM startups bicycle accident 2002

real_qa.q: What rituals did Mark Beller use to process grief after losing his wife?
real_qa.r: Mark Beller discovered that rituals could do real work that logic couldn't, including lighting a candle every month, sharing a toast with his wife's favorite tequila, and taking a walk up the route she loved. He also walked the Camino Portuguesa alone and in silence, coming back different—the same way he had the first time he did something like it decades earlier, the week before he met his wife Lotus.
real_qa.requete: Mark Beller grief rituals candle tequila Camino Portuguesa

real_qa.q: Where is Mark Beller migrating the Career Pivot website content and when will the original site disappear?
real_qa.r: Mark Beller is migrating most of the content from the Career Pivot website to Substack and will publish something every Monday, alternating between podcast episodes and Substack posts. The Career Pivot website will disappear in early December after being part of his identity for 15 years since he launched it in early 2012.
real_qa.requete: Career Pivot website migration Substack December 2024
